name: A Serving of Strength
summary: A trainer asks you to feed Rog’mar trainees at the training grounds. The stew helps keep them fed while defending the supply lines grows difficult.

sections.title: Food for Trainees
sections.body: The trainees at the training grounds need food, and their trainer sends you with hearty stew. You are to feed the Rog’mar trainees to the west. Their complaints can wait; defending the supply lines has grown difficult, and the warriors are thankful for the food you bring.

faq.answer: Rog’mar trainees at the training grounds need the stew.

faq.q: Where do I take the stew?
faq.answer: The Rog’mar trainees are at the training grounds to the west.

faq.q: Why are they being fed stew?
faq.answer: The stew keeps the trainees fed while defending the supply lines has become difficult.

faq.q: What does the trainer think of the trainees' complaints?
faq.answer: The trainer says the trainees can bring any further complaints directly to them.

faq.q: Is the trainer thankful for the food?
faq.answer: Yes. The trainer and the warriors are thankful for the food, despite what the warriors say.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Serving of Strength
